description: This file defines the TransactionsState class, which manages and filters financial transactions (income and expenses) for a specified month. It includes functions to add transactions, calculate totals, and provide formatted currency output, serving as a core state management component in a Kotlin-based Android finance application.

classes.name: TransactionsState
classes.description: Manages transaction data and operations such as filtering, adding transactions, and calculating totals for a specific month.

methods.name: setMonth
methods.description: Sets the current month for filtering transactions.

methods.name: addIncome
methods.description: Adds an income transaction to the state.

methods.name: addExpense
methods.description: Adds an expense transaction to the state.

methods.name: monthTransactions
methods.description: Retrieves transactions for the selected month, sorted by date descending.

methods.name: incomeTotal
methods.description: Calculates total income for the selected month.

methods.name: expenseTotal
methods.description: Calculates total expenses for the selected month.

methods.name: netBalance
methods.description: Calculates net balance (income minus expenses) for the selected month.
